verdict.rationale: Tailscale provides SSH access to nodes and even a built-in 'Tailscale SSH' feature to manage SSH authentication/authorization (tailscale-docs-26), and users report SSHing into machines over the tailnet (tailscale-docs-7, tailscale-comm-1). However, none of the evidence confirms support for standard Ed25519/ECDSA/RSA key-based authentication—Tailscale SSH instead relies on its own identity/certificate-based auth model, not user-supplied key types. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Ed25519/ECDSA/RSA key support, confirmation that traditional key-based SSH (vs Tailscale's own auth) is used or compatible.
